description: This file defines a custom Keras layer and a function for filtering object detection results, including applying score thresholds and non-maximum suppression (NMS). It is part of an object detection pipeline, likely used in a RetinaNet implementation, to process detection boxes, scores, and labels.

classes.name: FilterDetections
classes.description: A custom Keras layer that filters detection boxes based on score threshold and applies non-maximum suppression (NMS) to reduce overlapping detections.

methods.name: filter_detections
methods.description: Filters detection boxes, scores, and labels based on score threshold and applies NMS if enabled. Supports class-specific filtering and pads outputs to a fixed size.
